tagline.en: AllenAI's open vision-language-action policy for robot manipulation, built on the Molmo/OLMo family.
tagline.zh: AllenAI 开放的机器人操作视觉-语言-动作策略，构建于 Molmo/OLMo 家族之上。

en: MolmoBot is an open vision-language-action (VLA) policy from AllenAI, built on their Molmo / OLMo vision-language models. It takes camera images and a language instruction and predicts robot actions for manipulation tasks.

WorldFoundry provides the DROID checkpoints, including an OLMo-based policy and a Pi0-style variant (both Apache-2.0), plus image-conditioned and multitask checkpoints. It runs through a flattened, inference-only wrapper in-tree, so it doesn't depend on an external MolmoBot checkout at runtime.
In WorldFoundry you stage a checkpoint locally and run the policy directly; it emits an action chunk for the robot rather than an image or video.
zh: MolmoBot 是 AllenAI 推出的开放视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，构建在其 Molmo / OLMo 视觉-语言模型之上。它接收相机图像与语言指令，为操作任务预测机器人动作。
WorldFoundry 接入了 DROID 系列 checkpoint，包括一个基于 OLMo 的策略和一个 Pi0 风格的变体（两者均为 Apache-2.0），以及图像条件化与多任务 checkpoint。它通过内置的、扁平化的仅推理封装运行，因此在运行时不依赖外部的 MolmoBot 代码。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你把 checkpoint 放到本地并直接运行该策略；它输出给机器人的一段动作，而非图像或视频。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want an openly-licensed VLA baseline from the Molmo/OLMo family for robot manipulation, with DROID checkpoints ready to run.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个来自 Molmo/OLMo 家族、开放许可的机器人操作 VLA 基线，并希望有现成可运行的 DROID checkpoint 时使用。

notFor.en: Its output is an action chunk for robot control, not video or images. The simulator, real-robot clients, and training code are not part of this runtime, and the Pi0 variant carries extra dependencies; stage checkpoints locally before use.
notFor.zh: 它的输出是用于机器人控制的动作，而非视频或图像。仿真器、真机客户端与训练代码不属于该运行时，Pi0 变体还带有额外依赖；使用前请把 checkpoint 放到本地。

en: Open VLA policy on the Molmo / OLMo family
DROID checkpoints, OLMo-based and Pi0-style, both Apache-2.0
Also includes image-conditioned and multitask checkpoints
In-tree inference wrapper, no external checkout at runtime
zh: 基于 Molmo / OLMo 家族的开放 VLA 策略
DROID checkpoint，含 OLMo 版与 Pi0 风格版，均为 Apache-2.0
另含图像条件化与多任务 checkpoint
内置推理封装，运行时无需外部代码
